title: Tourne à gauche !
en: The imperative: giving directions and orders
intro: The **imperative** is for orders, directions and advice: *Tourne à gauche ! Prenez le métro ! Allons-y !* It has only three forms — **tu, nous, vous** — and no subject pronoun.

cases.label: tu form: tourne !
cases.rule: Use the **tu** form without **tu**. For **-er** verbs (and *aller*), drop the **-s**: *tu tournes → Tourne !*, *tu vas → Va !* Other verbs keep it: *Prends ! Fais ! Viens !*

cases.label: nous form: allons !
cases.rule: The **nous** form means *Let's…*: *Allons au cinéma ! Mangeons !*

cases.label: vous form: tournez !
cases.rule: The **vous** form is polite or plural: *Tournez à droite ! Prenez la deuxième rue !*

cases.label: être, avoir, savoir
cases.rule: **être**: *sois, soyons, soyez*. **avoir**: *aie, ayons, ayez*. (*Sois gentil ! N'aie pas peur !*)

cases.label: ne … pas: ne tourne pas !
cases.rule: Put **ne … pas** around the verb: *Ne tourne pas ! Ne prenez pas ce bus !*

cases.label: lève-toi ! / ne te lève pas !
cases.rule: Reflexive pronoun **after** the verb in positive orders (*Lève-toi ! Dépêchez-vous !*), **before** it in negative ones (*Ne te lève pas !*).

cases.label: vas-y ! allez-y !
cases.rule: Before **y**, *va* takes back its **s** to make a link: **Vas-y !** (go on!). Also *Allez-y ! Allons-y !*

cases.label: instructions with the infinitive
cases.rule: Signs, recipes and instructions often use the infinitive instead: *Tourner à droite. Ajouter le sel. Ne pas fumer.*

sections.title: 1. Three forms, no subject
sections.tip: **-er** verbs (and *aller*) lose the **-s** of the tu form: *tu manges → Mange !* Other verbs keep it: *tu prends → Prends !*

sections.title: 4. Reflexive verbs
text: In a positive order, the pronoun goes **after** the verb (te → **toi**). In a negative order, it goes back **before** the verb.

sections.title: 5. Vas-y ! Allez-y !
text: **y** means *there*. Before **y**, the tu form *va* takes back its **s**, so the words link: **Vas-y** /va.zi/ = go on! go ahead!

sections.title: 6. Instructions with the infinitive
text: On signs, in recipes and in instructions, French often uses the infinitive: it's neutral, neither *tu* nor *vous*.
sections.tip: With the infinitive, **ne pas** stays together before the verb: *Ne pas toucher* (do not touch).

mistakes.why: -er verbs drop the **-s** in the tu form.
No subject pronoun in the imperative.
In a negative order, the pronoun goes before the verb.

story.title: Le GPS
story.en: Hugo drives Antoine to the airport — with a GPS and Léa giving directions.

lines.fr: Dimanche, Antoine rentre à Montréal. Hugo [l'|le-pron]emmène à l'aéroport en voiture.
lines.en: On Sunday, Antoine goes home to Montreal. Hugo drives him to the airport.

lines.fr: Léa, {sois gentille|imp-irregular}. Le GPS sait, pas toi !
lines.en: Léa, be nice. The GPS knows — you don't!
At the roundabout, take the second exit.

lines.fr: {N'aie pas peur|imp-irregular}, Hugo, on a le temps.
lines.en: Don't worry, Hugo, we have time.

lines.fr: Mais il y a beaucoup de voitures sur la route…
lines.en: But there are lots of cars on the road…
Hurry up! The plane leaves at noon!
Calm down, Léa! Don't get worked up!

lines.fr: Hugo… {regarde le panneau|imp-tu} : c'est la route de Paris !
lines.en: Hugo… look at the sign: this is the road to Paris!

lines.fr: Sur le panneau, on lit : « Aéroport : {tourner à droite|imp-infinitive}. »

lines.en: Let's go! Go on, Hugo, quickly!

lines.fr: À onze heures et demie, ils arrivent enfin à l'aéroport.
lines.en: At half past eleven, they finally arrive at the airport.

lines.fr: Merci pour tout ! {Venez à Montréal|imp-vous} cet été !
lines.en: Thanks for everything! Come to Montreal this summer!

quiz.why: -er verbs drop the **-s** in the tu form.

quiz.en: Take the second street on the right.

quiz.q: How do you say “Don't turn here!” to a friend?
How do you say “Don't get up!” to a friend?
quiz.why: In a negative order, the pronoun goes back **before** the verb.

quiz.q: On a sign, « Ne pas fumer » means…
In a recipe, « Ajouter le sel » means…
